defs.def: a particular length of time 一段时间；时期

ex.s: Loan periods are established by the lending library.
ex.t: 一切都感觉自由而轻松。

ex.s: Moreover, these data are biased and favor certain regions, time periods, and species.
ex.t: 此外，这些数据存在偏差，偏向某些地区、时段和物种。

ex.s: This tour transports you back in time to one of San Francisco’s most fantastic periods, the 1950s!
ex.t: 这趟旅程带你穿越时空回到旧金山最精彩的时期之一——二十世纪五十年代！

ex.s: The letters were Tolkien’s way of keeping Father Christmas alive for his four children, over a period of more than twenty years.
ex.t: 这些信件是托尔金在二十多年的时间里为他的四个孩子保持圣诞老人活着的方式。

ex.s: Unusual animal behavior, for example, can indicate whether it’s cold, wet weather that’s on the way or a hot, dry period.
ex.t: 例如，不寻常的动物行为可以预示即将到来的是寒冷潮湿的天气还是炎热干燥的天气。

ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对该主题进行的戏剧性展示，时长不超过10分钟。若使用了特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

ex.s: But not all cities develop slowly over a long period of time.
ex.t: 但并非所有城市都在很长一段时间内缓慢发展。

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。

ex.s: 74  The synapses in the mice taken at the end of a period of sleep were 18 percent smaller than those taken before sleep, showing that the connections between neurons weaken while sleeping.
ex.t: 74  在一段睡眠结束时取出小鼠的突触比睡眠前取出的小18%，表明神经元之间的连接在睡眠时减弱。

ex.s: Snack periods are held throughout the day.
ex.t: 全天都有加餐时间。

ex.s: Caused by exceptionally heavy snowfall within a short period of time, they destroyed buildings and forest, and claimed over 256 lives.
ex.t: 由于在短时间内降下异常大雪，他们摧毁了建筑物和森林，夺去了256人的生命。

defs.def: a length of time in the life of a particular person or in the history of a particular country （人生或国家历史的）阶段，时期，时代

ex.s: to remind people of a historical period
ex.t: 以唤起人们对一个历史时期的记忆

ex.s: Art exhibitions can have many themes, such as a historical period, a location or a trend.
ex.t: 艺术展览可以有许多主题，如一个历史时期、一个地点或一种潮流。

ex.s: His biographical accounts and depictions of historical events, such as the Long March, therefore captured the spirit of the period and the people living through it with unprecedented authenticity.
ex.t: 他关于长征等历史事件的传记性叙述和描绘，因此以空前的真实感刻画了那个时代及身处其中的人们的精神。

ex.s: Twenty-five Young Leaders are being selected every two years for a four-year period.
ex.t: 每两年选出25名青年领袖，任期四年。

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

ex.s: The team showed that this change in bite was connected with the development of agriculture in the Neolithic period.
ex.t: 团队表明，这种咬合变化与新石器时代农业的发展有关。

ex.s: After a three-year pilot period, the GPNP will be officially set up next year.
ex.t: 经过三年试点期，GPNP将于明年正式建立。

ex.s: What will UNESCO provide for the internship period？
ex.t: 联合国教科文组织将在实习期间提供什么？

ex.s: It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 不了解一个历史时期，几乎不可能不对相关概念产生几十个问题。

ex.s: reading novels is a way to learn about a historical period
ex.t: 读小说是了解某个历史时期的一种方式

ex.s: It is a little-studied period of history.
ex.t: 这是一个鲜少被研究的历史时期。

defs.def: a length of time which is a division of an era. A period is divided into epochs. 纪（地质年代，代下分纪）
any of the parts that a day is divided into at a school, college, etc. for study 节；学时；课

ex.s: An essay not submitted in class on the due date will lose a letter grade for each class period it is late.
ex.t: 如果作文未在截止日期当天课堂上提交，每逾期一个课时就会降低一个字母等级。
